Keyed.MBBS_MoreTip: Buttons collapsed into the drawer. The drawer has its own settings button at the bottom.
Keyed.MBBS_ModSettings_InGame: Opened in a game: changes apply to the current save.
Keyed.MBBS_ModSettings_MainMenu: Opened from the main menu: changes apply to the default template that new games start with.
Keyed.MBBS_AlwaysDrawBar: Always draw the bar with this mod (for testing)
Keyed.MBBS_AlwaysDrawBarTip: Until you change something, the game keeps drawing the bar itself. Turn this on to compare this mod's drawing with the game's.
Keyed.MBBS_ViewTip: Advanced shows more options: widths, fixed positions, label alignment, hotkeys and compatibility. The choice is kept for every save.
Keyed.MBBS_OriginallyHiddenTip: Buttons their mod keeps off the bar on purpose. Turn on "Always show" in Advanced to put one on the bar.
Keyed.MBBS_OrderHint: Top to bottom = left to right on screen. Drag rows to reorder.
Keyed.MBBS_NotShowingNowTip: Not on the bar right now: the button's own condition is not met.
Keyed.MBBS_FillScreenTip: When the buttons fit, stretch them to use the whole width.
Keyed.MBBS_MenuLocked: Lock the game menu button at the right end
Keyed.MBBS_MenuLockedTip: While locked, the menu button cannot be hidden, moved or put in the drawer; it can only be renamed.
Keyed.MBBS_MenuUnlockedNote: The game menu button has been unlocked in Advanced.
Keyed.MBBS_MenuLockedNote: The game menu button is locked at the right end and can only be renamed. Unlock it in Advanced, on the whole bar row.
Keyed.MBBS_Info_OriginallyHidden: Its mod keeps it off the bar on purpose; it appears only with "Always show".
Keyed.MBBS_ButtonWidthFollow: Width: same as the whole bar
Keyed.MBBS_ForceShowTip: Show the button even when its own condition says it should not appear. Clicking it may then do nothing.
Keyed.MBBS_TemplateSaved: Saved as the default template. New games will start with this arrangement.
Keyed.MBBS_ResetAllConfirm: Reset every setting to the untouched bar (the game plus what other mods changed)? This does not apply the template.
Keyed.MBBS_Compat_TheirsNotice: Detected {0}: it currently controls the bar, so changes here take effect only when this mod has priority.
Keyed.MBBS_Compat_OursNotice: Detected {0}: this mod has priority, so its effect on the bar is switched off.
Keyed.MBBS_Notice_UIRethemed_TheyDraw: {0} is drawing the bottom bar, so the settings here have no effect. To use this mod's bar, turn off "Main bar" in its mod settings, or put this mod above it in the mod list.
Keyed.MBBS_Notice_UIRethemed_BothOn: {0} also has "Main bar" on: it places the bottom-right controls and window positions as if its own bar were shown, so things may be out of place. Turning off "Main bar" in its mod settings is recommended.
Keyed.MBBS_Compat_Ours_Desc: This mod draws the bar. {0}'s effect on the bar is switched off; its settings are only used as reference values.
Keyed.MBBS_Compat_Theirs_Desc: {0} keeps the bar. This mod only keeps its settings window.
Keyed.MBBS_Compat_RestartNeeded: Takes effect after restarting the game.
Keyed.MBBS_Compat_Imported: Imported the arrangement from {0}. Press Save to keep it.
Keyed.MBBS_HotKeyGameNote: Shared by all saves; the same key as in Options > Keyboard.
Keyed.MBBS_HotKeyCustomNote: Shared by all saves. This button has no entry in Options > Keyboard, so this mod keeps the key.
Keyed.MBBS_Export_ModXml: Copy as mod XML (for making an arrangement mod)
Keyed.MBBS_Export_ModXmlCopied: Def XML copied. Put it in a .xml file under your mod's Defs folder.
Keyed.MBBS_Import_Done: Arrangement imported into this window. Press Save to keep it.
Keyed.MBBS_Import_NotXml: That is not an exported arrangement (not valid XML).
Keyed.MBBS_Import_NoConfig: That text has no arrangement in it.
Keyed.MBBS_Import_Unsafe: That text asks to create program classes, which an arrangement never needs. Not imported.
Keyed.MBBS_Import_TooNew: Made by a newer version of this mod (format {0}; this version reads up to {1}). Update the mod first.
Keyed.MBBS_DrawerCellWidthFollow: Drawer cell width: same as the default button width
Keyed.MBBS_LabelAlignTip: Where button labels sit. Buttons that only show an icon are not affected.
Keyed.MBBS_ThemeHeaderTip: Themes change how the bar and its buttons look. Theme mods that list Main Button Bar System as a dependency appear here too. The choice is saved with this save (or with the template at the main menu).
Keyed.MBBS_ScrollArrowsNote: Arrows appear only when the buttons do not fit. While they fit, the bar does not need to scroll.
Keyed.MBBS_HotKeyConflictHeader: The key {0} is also used by:
Keyed.MBBS_HotKeyConflictExplainGame: When two bindings share a key, pressing it triggers only one of them. Change one of them in Options > Keyboard, or pick another key here.
Keyed.MBBS_HotKeyConflictExplainCustom: This mod handles the keys it keeps after the game's own, so the bindings above take this key first and this button will not react. Pick another key here, or change the other binding in Options > Keyboard.
Keyed.MBBS_IconModeTip: The game shows only the icon when a button has one, and only the text otherwise.
Keyed.MBBS_IconMissingNote: The chosen icon cannot be found, so the button's own icon is used.
Keyed.MBBS_RefHeader: Other mods' settings for this button (reference only):
Keyed.MBBS_IconModeAllTip: How every button shows its icon and label, unless a button has its own setting.
Keyed.MBBS_IconModeClearAll: Make all {0} buttons with their own setting follow this
Keyed.MBBS_Export_ModFolder: Create an arrangement mod (ready to upload)
Keyed.MBBS_ExportHint_Clipboard: The text includes the name, author and which mod each button comes from, so whoever imports it sees what is missing.
Keyed.MBBS_ExportHint_File: Saved in {0}. Files placed there by others show up under Import.
Keyed.MBBS_ExportHint_ModXml: A def for your own mod's Defs folder. Icons you imported as PNG are not included: use "Create an arrangement mod" for that.
Keyed.MBBS_ExportHint_ModFolder: Creates a mod in {1}: About.xml (requires Main Button Bar System), the arrangement, and the PNG icons it uses. Subscribers find it under Import.
Keyed.MBBS_Export_BadPackageId: A package ID is two or more parts joined by dots, each starting with an English letter, using only English letters, digits and _ (for example Author.MyArrangement).
Keyed.MBBS_ModFolder_Usage: An arrangement for Main Button Bar System. Open its settings, press Import and pick "{0}".
Keyed.MBBS_ImportReport_MadeWith: Made with RimWorld {0}, Main Button Bar System {1}.
Keyed.MBBS_ImportReport_Missing: Not in your game, so their settings are skipped: {0}
Keyed.MBBS_ImportReport_OnlyHere: Only in your game, keeping your settings (new ones go before the menu): {0} ({1})
Keyed.MBBS_ImportReport_NoList: This arrangement does not list the buttons of the game it was made in (older version). Buttons it does not mention keep your settings.
Keyed.MBBS_ImportReport_ThemeMissing: Theme {0} (from {1}) is not installed; the vanilla look is used until it is.
Keyed.MBBS_ImportReport_ModeMissing: Display mode {0} (from {1}) is not installed; the vanilla bar is used until it is.
Keyed.MBBS_ImportReport_IconFilesMissing: Imported icons you do not have: {0} ({1}). Put the PNG files in {2}; until then those buttons keep their own icon.
Keyed.MBBS_ImportReport_IconTexturesMissing: Icons from mods you do not have: {0} ({1}). Those buttons keep their own icon.
Keyed.MBBS_ImportPart_Layout_Desc: Display mode, order, hidden buttons, the More drawer, pinned ends and the menu lock.
Keyed.MBBS_ImportPart_Sizes_Desc: Button widths, gap, fill screen, label alignment, the More button, arrows, drawer grid and wheel speed.
Keyed.MBBS_ImportPart_Names_Desc: Custom names. Buttons it leaves unnamed go back to their own name.
Keyed.MBBS_ImportPart_Icons_Desc: Text / icon display for the bar and each button, and chosen icons.
Keyed.MBBS_ImportPart_Theme_Desc: The look from the Appearance tab.
Keyed.MBBS_ImportPart_NotSet: (not set in this arrangement: importing resets yours)
Keyed.MBBS_IllustrationNone: This theme has no background image or decorations, so there is nothing to adjust here.
Keyed.MBBS_DecorationsShownTip: Images the theme places on the bar or in the drawer, such as a character portrait. Turn off to hide them all.
Keyed.MBBS_ReloadThemesTip: Development mode: reads every theme's PNG files again from its mod folder, so an edited image shows without restarting the game. The themes are checked again afterwards; see the log.
Keyed.MBBS_ThemesReloaded: Theme textures reloaded: {0} file(s) read again.

MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.Vanilla.label: vanilla
MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.Vanilla.description: Like the base game: the screen width is shared equally. No scrolling and no drawer.
MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.Collapse.label: collapse
MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.Collapse.description: Buttons marked "Drawer" move into the More drawer; the rest share the bar.
MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.Scroll.label: scroll
MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.Scroll.description: Buttons keep their width; scroll the bar with the mouse wheel or the arrows. The drawer is not used.
MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.CollapseScroll.label: collapse + scroll
MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.CollapseScroll.description: The drawer works as in Collapse; the remaining buttons scroll.

MainButtonBarSystem.BarAppearanceDef.Vanilla.label: vanilla
MainButtonBarSystem.BarAppearanceDef.MBBS_Imperial.label: imperial
MainButtonBarSystem.BarAppearanceDef.MBBS_Imperial.description: Navy and gold with crowned corners and a psy-teal glow, from the Royalty expansion's colours.
MainButtonBarSystem.BarAppearanceDef.MBBS_Creed.label: creed
MainButtonBarSystem.BarAppearanceDef.MBBS_Creed.description: Deep teal with coral borders and gold roundels, from the Ideology expansion's colours.
MainButtonBarSystem.BarAppearanceDef.MBBS_GeneLab.label: gene lab
MainButtonBarSystem.BarAppearanceDef.MBBS_GeneLab.description: Teal-blue with teal borders, deep red gene tiles and pale teal labels, from the Biotech expansion's colours.
MainButtonBarSystem.BarAppearanceDef.MBBS_Void.label: void
MainButtonBarSystem.BarAppearanceDef.MBBS_Void.description: Void black with sage-green borders, a thin red line that glows under the mouse, and shard-cut corners, from the Anomaly expansion's colours.
MainButtonBarSystem.BarAppearanceDef.MBBS_Starfarer.label: starfarer
MainButtonBarSystem.BarAppearanceDef.MBBS_Starfarer.description: Space purple with purple hull plates, cyan rivets and a cyan thruster line, from the Odyssey expansion's colours.
MainButtonBarSystem.BarAppearanceDef.MBBS_Nai.label: nai
MainButtonBarSystem.BarAppearanceDef.MBBS_Nai.description: Anime-style theme in Nai's colours: deep navy buttons with grey-white borders, graphite lines and a violet glow, and a translucent character illustration behind the left end of the bar.
